title: RelationshipPulse
description: Per-relationship rollup across multiple practice rounds. Tracks the trajectory of one (user, counterparty) pair: health score, trend, recurring patterns, emerging concerns, wins, next-step recommendation. Produced by Step 11; consumes Step 06 PersonVault and Step 07/09/10 round artifacts.

person_id.description: FK to PersonVault.person_id. Forced from PersonVault input; the model is not trusted to re-emit it.

person_name.description: Display name copied from PersonVault.name (e.g. 'Jamie', 'Mom'). Optional — older pulses may not carry it.

version.description: Bumped by the runtime on each incremental update (v1 from prior=None, v2 from prior v1, etc.).

round_count.description: Number of practice rounds reflected in round_summaries. Pulse requires at least 2 rounds — a single-round trajectory does not exist.

health_score.description: Overall relationship health right now, in [0, 1]. 1.0 = thriving (goals met consistently, predictable, low surprise risk). 0.0 = broken (goals missed, volatile, no working de-escalation moves). This is a point-in-time read, not a cumulative average.

health_trend.description: Direction of travel across the rounds. 'volatile' is for trajectories that swing more than they trend; 'insufficient_data' is for pulses where the rounds don't carry enough signal (no aftermaths, all goal_status=unknown) to call it.

trajectory_summary.description: Short prose (~2-4 sentences) on how the relationship has moved across the rounds, addressed to the user as 'you'.

round_summaries.description: One compact entry per practice round, in chronological order (oldest first). round_id is the cross-reference key for recurring_patterns.evidence_round_ids.

round_id.description: Stable id for this round; forced from the input round record.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this round started. Forced from input.

goal_status.description: Round-level goal outcome. 'unknown' is for rounds that did not produce an aftermath.

prediction_accuracy.description: Copied from this round's aftermath.prediction_accuracy. Defaults to 0.0 when the round has no aftermath.

headline.description: Single sentence on what mattered in this round, addressed to the user as 'you'.

recurring_patterns.description: Patterns observed in TWO OR MORE rounds. Each entry must cite at least two distinct round_ids from round_summaries as evidence — that is the definition of 'recurring'.

pattern.description: Plain-English description of the recurring shape (e.g. "Jamie opens defensively when you cite past commitments, then concedes once you reframe as joint problem-solving").

evidence_round_ids.description: round_ids from round_summaries where this pattern was observed. Must contain at least two distinct ids.

emerging_concerns.description: Risks that have surfaced in the most recent 1-2 rounds and weren't established patterns before. Empty array is valid when the recent rounds are clean.

concern.description: What is starting to slip, addressed to the user.

round_id.description: Optional. round_id where this surfaced; must be one of round_summaries when present.

relationship_wins.description: Durable wins worth carrying forward — moves the user has reliably made work with this counterparty, framings that have repeatedly landed. Accumulates across pulse versions (deduped, capped).

win.description: What has worked, addressed to the user.

round_id.description: Optional. round_id where the win first / most-recently surfaced.

next_step_recommendation.description: Single sentence: the single most useful thing to focus on with this person in the next round, addressed to the user.

pulse_id.description: Runtime-attached uuid for this pulse object.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this pulse was generated.
